title: Rank values with a sorted set
summary: A sorted set pairs each member with a score.
introduction: A sorted set pairs each member with a score. Your task: Change Mia's score and inspect the new order.
learningObjectives: Change Mia's score and inspect the new order.
Explain the example for rank values with a sorted set

blocks.text: A sorted set pairs each member with a score. Redis can return members ordered by that score.
Use a local Redis server and redis-cli. Commands here use cma: practice keys only. Redis commands do not run in the site's SQLite playground. Do not connect these exercises to a production database.

blocks.code:
DEL cma:scores
ZADD cma:scores 5 Mia 8 Sam 3 Ravi
ZRANGE cma:scores 0 -1 WITHSCORES
blocks.title: Rank values with a sorted set

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `ZADD` gives each sorted-set member a numeric score used for ordering.

blocks.text: The ascending order is Ravi with 3, Mia with 5, then Sam with 8.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: A sorted-set score is a number used for ordering. The member name is still unique within the set.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Change Mia's score and inspect the new order.
